audience: localization managers and developers who translate their software in Crowdin

useCases.title: Check translation progress by language
useCases.text: The AI reads the translation and approval percentage for each target language of a project. You see which languages are behind.

useCases.title: See open tasks and who has them
useCases.text: The AI lists translation and proofreading tasks with title, status and assignees. It can add the project members and their roles.

useCases.title: Browse the files and branches of a project
useCases.text: The AI lists source files with path, type and status, plus directories and version branches. You get a map of what is in the project.

useCases.title: Review source strings and their context
useCases.text: The AI lists source strings with text, identifier and context. It can spot unclear or inconsistent wording for you to fix.

useCases.title: Add a source string or a translation
useCases.text: The AI adds a new source string to a file, or adds a translation for a source string in a target language. It can add many one by one.
